title: JSolver: Joint Spectrum Estimation and Multi-Material Decomposition from Single-Energy CT Projections
abstract: arXiv:2505.08123v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-material decomposition (MMD) enables quantitative reconstruction of tissue compositions in the human body, supporting a wide range of clinical applications. However, traditional MMD typically requires spectral CT scanners and pre-measured X-ray energy spectra, significantly limiting clinical applicability. To this end, various methods have been developed to perform MMD using conventional (i.e., single-energy, SE) CT systems, commonly referred to as SEMMD. Despite promising progress, most SEMMD methods follow a two-step image decomposition pipeline, which first reconstructs monochromatic CT images using algorithms such as FBP, and then performs decomposition on these images. translated_title: JSolver：从单能CT投影中进行联合能谱估计与多材料分解
translated_abstract: 多材料分解（MMD）能够对人体内组织成分进行定量重建，支持广泛的临床应用。然而，传统的MMD通常需要能谱CT扫描仪和预先测量的X射线能谱，这显著限制了其临床适用性。为此，人们开发了多种方法，利用传统（即单能，SE）CT系统执行MMD，通常被称为SEMMD。尽管取得了可喜的进展，但大多数SEMMD方法遵循两步图像分解流程，即首先使用FBP等算法重建单色CT图像，然后对这些图像执行分解。然而，初始重建步骤忽略了人体组织的能量依赖性衰减，会在后续分解中引入严重的非线性束硬化伪影和噪声。本文提出了JSolver，一种从根本上重新（原文截断）……
tldr: 本文提出JSolver方法，直接从单能CT投影数据中联合进行X射线能谱估计与多材料分解，避免了传统两步重建-分解流程引入的束硬化伪影和噪声问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes JSolver, which jointly performs X-ray spectrum estimation and multi-material decomposition directly from single-energy CT projections, avoiding beam hardening artifacts and noise introduced by conventional two-step reconstruction-decomposition pipelines.
